Jackpot meter rules: every 3 MINI collected = 10x base bet, every 4 MINOR = 20x, every 5 MAJOR = 100x, every 6 GRAND = 2000x. GRAND (2000x) is also awarded separately if the entire Respins grid fills with MONEY symbols.
Max win is capped at 5,000x total bet; if reached mid-round, the Respins round ends immediately, the win is paid, and remaining respins are forfeited.

Payout basis: rules say wins are 'multiplied by bet per line', but symbols[].payouts here are total-bet multipliers ($ / $2.00 demo total bet) per our API convention -- bases differ by the 25-line divisor.

Win expression rule, verbatim from paytable_p6.png: 'Only the highest win is paid per winning combination on the same pay way. When winning on multiple pay ways, all wins are added to the total win. Free Spins and Respin wins are added to the pay-way win. All wins are multiplied by the base bet. All values are expressed as actual wins in coins.' Dollar paytable values in this documentation were converted to total-bet multipliers (dollar value / $2.00 demo bet) for portability.

PAYOUT BASIS (explicit, read this before comparing symbols across slots): the multipliers stored here are expressed versus TOTAL BET, i.e. 5 lanterns on a single way pays 25x the total bet ($50.00 at the demo's $2.00 total bet). Payout basis: paytable values are shown at the $2.00 demo total bet across 40 fixed lines (bet per line = $0.05). Rules text states 'All wins are multiplied by bet per line.' Dividing every symbol payout by $0.05 (including WILD and the pays-anywhere SCATTER) yields clean whole-number multipliers for all 8 symbols (e.g. apple 3/4/5 = 15/250/1200; scatter 3/4/5 = 200/600/20000); dividing instead by the $2.00 total bet produces non-clean fractions for 3-of-a-kind low-value fruits (e.g. $0.75/$2.00 = 0.375, not a multiple of $0.05). Bet-per-line ($0.05) was therefore used as the single unit basis for every symbol, matching the game's own stated rule.
